_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Tuesday April 14th | 6:51 a.m

Bonjour Tremblant!

Since our earlier update, the sun has come out over the mountain, bringing a beautiful sunrise and more winter-like conditions, with -1°C at the summit. The morning is shaping up to be a great time to hit the slopes. Warmer temperatures and some rain are expected to return later today.

Lift Operations This Week:

North Side
  • Duncan Express — open as of 8:30 a.m.
  • Expo Chair — closed for the week
  • Lowell Thomas Chair — closed for the week
South Side
  • Télécabine Express — open as of 8:30 a.m.
  • Flying Mile — closed for the week
  • TGV — closed for the week
  • Soleil Side — closed for the week
  • Équilibre — closed for the Season
  • Edge — closed for the Season
  • Porte Du Soleil — closed for the Season
We look forward to seeing you on the slopes and enjoying a great day on the mountain together!

Mountain safety tip of the week: Assist Ski Patrol.
If you witness or are involved in an accident, remain at the scene and provide your identification to ski patrol.
When you see our patrollers or safety staff responding on the slopes, slow down and make sure to give them space by staying at least 5 metres away from the incident area.

Snow fall is recorded daily at 5 a.m from mid-mountain at North Side (550 m / 1,800 ft). This data, based on 24 hours, provides a picture of on-mountain conditions. Actual accumulation may differ from the official report. Be aware of changing conditions. Lifts and trails exist in a mountain environment and may close due to weather, usage and/or special maintenance.
_inspectorSnowReport.SafetyReport: It’s a rainy Tuesday morning, bringing mild, spring-like conditions to the mountain. Our teams have been hard at work getting the slopes ready, offering two terrain parks along with a selection of freshly groomed runs. More terrain will open gradually throughout the day as conditions permit. We look forward to seeing you on the slopes and enjoying a great day on the mountain together!
_inspectorSnowReport.SafetyReportFrench: Bon mardi matin pluvieux, apportant des conditions douces et printanières sur la montagne. Nos équipes ont travaillé fort pour préparer les pistes, vous offrant deux parcs à neige ainsi qu’une belle sélection de pistes fraîchement damées. D’autres pistes ouvriront progressivement au cours de la journée selon les conditions.  Nous avons hâte de vous accueillir sur les pistes et de profiter pleinement de cette journée à la montagne avec vous !
